_doc: Ground truth for replay.py. `labels`: one entry per issue a reviewer raised or the fab history recorded (FINDINGS R1-S1-F*,
R1-Z1-F*, P0-T9, P1-T18), with severity (blocker 3, major 2, minor 1), the attempt it is on, tool_catchable, and locators.
A locator is {report, pattern}: a regex over the lines replay.py makes from that run's report (see replay.py LINES). A label
is caught by a line whose status (fail/warn/info) the scoring reads; `partial: true` marks a locator that covers only part
of the issue. `process: true` labels (overclaims, a wrong clock) are out of every denominator.
`known_true_positives`: fails the tools report that no reviewer raised but which are right; they excuse false_fails and credit nothing.
`negatives`: boards that must NOT fail a given row (plink-fixed: the rework); a fail there counts as a false fail.
